cases.hypothesis: The vertical distance between the two divisi staves was too large, or divisi brackets/braces were missed, preventing them from being grouped into a single system by system_grouping. This caused sequential numbering instead of parallel numbering.

Two separate systems were vertically too close to each other, leading system_grouping to merge them into a single system (as if they were divisi). Consequently, separate measures on upper/lower staves were merged into single joint measures.
An indented system start or staff starting-point detection issue caused the non-measure margin region (e.g. clef, key signature) to be split by a false positive barline, forming an invalid measure 1.
A false positive barline was detected in the middle of a single measure, causing it to split into two separate measures (numbered 37 and 38).
The two divisi staves for R1-R4 and R5-R8 were not grouped together by system_grouping and remained as two separate systems, causing sequential numbering.
